info.text:
# Alundra

Item placement comes from the Alundra randomizer. Another slot's item can sit on one of your checks, and an item of yours can be placed in another game. The client grants that item once you have control.

Patching and connecting are in the [setup guide](setup_en.md). You supply your own USA 1.1 disc.

## Goal

Defeat Melzas. The client sends the goal when the ending loads, after the fight.

With the default settings, weapons, armor, and spells are progressive, boots stay separate items, all seven crests are in the pool, and the Lake Shrine seals start open. The crests lead to the fight. Checks on the shrine that need the bow, the flail, or the Spring Bean are still in the world. A new game starts with the dagger, cloth armor, and short boots.

Crests past the crest count are already on their pedestals.

## Checks

Chests, one-time shop purchases, and Merrick's trades are checks. The client reports a check once you have control.

Archipelago leaves the following out of the check list. Each one still receives an item. That item is never progression, and never from another slot.

- The eight shelves that restock at Lurvy's and Naomi's. Restocking Shop Items chooses what they sell. A useful item such as a ring can still land on a shelf the fill chooses. A full stack of Herbs, Strength Tonic, Strength Elixyr, Magic Elixyr, or Wonder Essence, sent from another game, is paid out as that item's shop price in gilder: 5, 20, 50, 30, or 200. These shelves are where you can buy the item again. At 9999 gilder the payout is still counted and the purse stays full.

Hints in the game are written when the disc is patched. Archipelago hint points are not used in the game.

Another player's item is shown as "player - item". The player name is kept to 16 printable ASCII characters and the item name to 28, so the line fits on the disc. The name you log in with is the full slot name.

## Shop prices for another player's item

Naomi's Item #4, Lurvy's Item #5, and the Life Vessel that replaces Lurvy's Item #5 can sell another player's item. The price follows how early that shelf can be reached, and whether the item is progression, useful, filler, or a trap. Sphere 1 is the first set of checks reachable at the start, the same numbering as the room's sphere tracker.

| Item | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Progression in sphere 1 through 4 | 100 gilder times the sphere |
| Progression in sphere 5 and later | 500 |
| Useful | 250 |
| Filler | 100 |
| Trap | 50 |

An Alundra item on those shelves keeps that item's own price.

## Credit

Dinopony wrote the original Alundra randomizer. This world patches with [alundra-randomizer](https://github.com/Lunesar/alundra-randomizer). The logic data in this repository is copied from there.

tutorials.text:
# Alundra Setup Guide

Patch a USA 1.1 disc and connect it to an Archipelago room through BizHawk.

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7 or newer
- `alundra.apworld` from this repository's Releases page
- Your own USA 1.1 disc image of Alundra, as a `.bin` file
- [BizHawk](https://tasvideos.org/BizHawk) 2.9 or newer, with the Nymashock core. Versions 2.7 and 2.8 also work after you set their Lua core to Lua+LuaInterface. Connect has the menu path.

The patcher ships inside the apworld and runs on Windows and Linux.

## Install the apworld

1. Install Archipelago.
2. In the Archipelago Launcher, choose Install APWorld and select `alundra.apworld`.

## Create a YAML

A YAML is your slot. The [Archipelago setup guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en) explains how a multiworld uses it.

After the apworld is installed, choose Generate Template Options in the Launcher. That writes an Alundra YAML with the Default preset and a comment on each setting. The preset is progressive items, split boots, Lake Shrine seals open, all seven crests in the pool, and the starting dagger, cloth armor, and short boots. The [game page](en_Alundra.md) describes the goal, which places count as checks, and how another player's item behaves.

An empty options block is the same preset:

```yaml
name: YourName
game: Alundra
Alundra: {}
```

Generation adds the dagger, cloth armor, and short boots when the starting inventory does not already list them.

## Generate

Put the YAML in Archipelago's `Players` folder and choose Generate in the Launcher. Host the zip from the Launcher, or upload it to [archipelago.gg](https://archipelago.gg).

Each Alundra slot has a file on the room page, offered as Download Patch File. The name ends in `.apalundra`.

## Join a room

Download your `.apalundra` file from the room page. Joining a room someone else generated skips the YAML and Generate steps.

## Patch a disc

1. In the Launcher, open `Alundra Patch`.
2. Choose the `.apalundra` file, then your USA 1.1 `.bin`.

The `Alundra Patch` tool writes a patched BIN/CUE in a folder next to that disc. The folder is named from the patch file. The disc you chose is left unchanged. With the spoiler log left on, the hint log is written in that same folder.

## Connect

Archipelago includes the Lua connector at `data/lua/connector_bizhawk_generic.lua`.

1. Open the patched disc in BizHawk with the Nymashock core. In Config > Customize, enable "Run in background" so the client stays connected when the window is not focused. On BizHawk 2.7 and 2.8, set the Lua core to Lua+LuaInterface under Config > Customize > Advanced, then restart BizHawk.
2. In EmuHawk, open Tools > Lua Console and leave that window open. Choose Script > Open Script and open `connector_bizhawk_generic.lua`.
3. In the Launcher, open BizHawk Client. The first time, it asks you to locate EmuHawk.
4. When the log says `Running handler for Alundra`, enter the room address, for example `archipelago.gg:38281`, and connect. The title screen stays unrecognized until you start the game and it loads.

The client reads the slot name from the disc. The log says `Logged in as <slot name>.` when the room accepts it. A vanilla disc, or a disc patched by a different release, never starts the handler. A disc patched for a different seed disconnects after login.

Once Alundra has control, the client sends opened chests, one-time shop purchases, and completed Merrick trades. An item found for you in another game is granted then. A full stack of a healing item is paid out as gilder. When the ending starts, the client sends the goal.

readme.text:
# Alundra for Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) world for Alundra (PlayStation). It places items with the Alundra randomizer, patches a USA 1.1 disc, and connects that disc to a multiworld through BizHawk.

## Play

Install [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7 or newer, then install `alundra.apworld` from this repository's Releases page. You need your own USA 1.1 disc image.

[docs/setup_en.md](docs/setup_en.md) is the player guide: the YAML, the patch button, and BizHawk. [docs/en_Alundra.md](docs/en_Alundra.md) is what a multiworld seed changes.

## Develop

`.apignore` leaves [docs/TODO.md](docs/TODO.md), [docs/client_memory.md](docs/client_memory.md), and [data/README.md](data/README.md) out of the apworld. The setup guide and the game page stay in.

Place the patcher under `patcher/linux` and `patcher/win32` from the [alundra-randomizer](https://github.com/Lunesar/alundra-randomizer) release named in `randomizer.lock.json`. The workflow artifacts are `alundra-aptools-linux` and `alundra-aptools-win64`.

## Credits

Dinopony wrote the original Alundra randomizer. This world patches with [alundra-randomizer](https://github.com/Lunesar/alundra-randomizer).

Released under the MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## AI Disclosure

Development was assisted with AI in the following ways:
- Parsing original game data and memory for client integration and game modification
- Writing unit tests
- Maintaining documentation
- Recommending code implementation

All AI generated code and documentation recommendations were manually reviewed, edited, iterated on, and approved by hand.
This repository contains no AI-generated art.

notes.text:
The apworld contains both the patcher and the bizhawk client. You only need your own USA Rev 1 (1.1) disc image.

## Bug fixes
- Fixed progressive boots logic that required more upgrades than intended
- Fixed game freezing when opening chests in seeds with a large number of Archipelago items

## Checks and locations
- Tarn's Manor table item (Book of Elna) is now a collected check
- Fairy Pond chests are now checks
- Fairy Pond reward chest can now be tracked as a check
- Fairy Pond stays open after the reward and can hold required items

## Quality of life
- Skip the Tarn Manor ambush scene (D3)

## Setup
See [docs/setup_en.md](https://github.com/Lunesar/alundra-apworld/blob/master/docs/setup_en.md): Archipelago 0.6.7+, install `alundra.apworld`, generate, patch, then BizHawk + the included Lua connector.

## Downloads
`alundra.apworld` is the only file players need. The patcher is included.
